approval.scope: Model, three couplings, three reference speeds and absolute tolerances

grading_policy: Compare three final scalars only; all must pass. Ignore extra ungraded fields. No method or intermediate checks.
reference_method: Independent DOP853, N=512, M=32; median downstream window speeds. Provenance only, not agent requirements.
tolerance_basis: Observed molecular-energy and numerical sensitivity envelope, not a statistical confidence interval.
limitations: Finite numerical evidence, not a statistical confidence interval.
Box/electronic/NEB shifts transferred from existing 520 eV tests; no new 650 eV box reoptimization.
Five-hour end-to-end runtime on the cluster has not been newly measured.
